title: Untrusted Pointer Dereference in ASUS certain motherboards firmware allows a kernel-level privileges user can supply…
description: An untrusted pointer dereference vulnerability exists in the firmware of certain ASUS motherboards. A user with kernel-level privileges can supply an arbitrary memory address via an I/O command, which may lead to tampering with system information or cause a system crash. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.8, indicating a medium severity level.
